Hi Priya,

I’m sorry for the disruption. We’ve flagged this as urgent and are actively investigating the API timeout issue now.

We’ve opened a high-priority internal ticket and will keep you updated as we learn more. If you can share any additional details such as the affected endpoint(s), approximate start time, request IDs, or sample timestamps, that would help us speed up diagnosis.

We understand this is blocking your users and are treating it as a priority.

Best,
Alice Chen
